# CLI

Every `hub` command as `hub help` lists it; `hub <command> --help` prints the lines of one. Where a command needs an author (`--by`, `--agent`, `--from`), `HUBD_AGENT` stands in for a flag left out ([Environment](env.md)). What the commands read and write is in [Files](files.md).

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`init`](#init) | scaffold a team folder (AGENTS.md, INBOX.md, queues/) |
| [`setup`](#setup) | put hubd into a harness's MCP config, after trying the server; --check reads the config back and tries what it holds |
| [`version`](#version) | installed hubd version, and which copy is answering |
| [`doctor`](#doctor) | check hub base, team root, locks, queues and writer versions |
| [`upgrade`](#upgrade) | refresh HUBD.md (the agent protocol) to the installed version |
| [`status`](#status) | project table |
| [`brief`](#brief) | morning brief |
| [`inbox`](#inbox) | what needs a decision now (blocked/overdue/unassigned/stale locks) |
| [`now`](#now) | the one next thing to do |
| [`agenda`](#agenda) | the day, split by who can act |
| [`plan`](#plan) | dependency-graph trajectory: ready now · critical path · unlock order · cycles |
| [`whereami`](#whereami) | where am I: project, digest age, tasks, claims, who is here, journal tail, git inventory — first command after a compaction |
| [`log`](#log) | journal tail; --since: all of the window; --json: every field, to included |
| [`watch`](#watch) | new journal entries, each shown once to the cursor &lt;name> |
| [`recall`](#recall) | ranked, dated hits across cards, tasks and the journal |
| [`report`](#report) | structured report → card sections (no input prints the template) |
| [`reflect`](#reflect) | the reflection digest: results and obstacles per role, the latest facts, repeated rules; candidates for the project's laws: a rule said 3 times by one role, or by 2 roles; the head's verdict on a candidate; an accepted one is a law, in hub_context; the project's laws, one per line |
| [`decide`](#decide) | append a decision to ## Decisions |
| [`next`](#next) | set ## Next step |
| [`task`](#task) | a new task; close a task; tasks; one task, and where else its id appears; move categories off the fixed list into tags (dry run without --apply) |
| [`card`](#card) | set a project card without a folder; fix lines of a card, leave the rest byte-for-byte; read a card back: whole, its sections as data, or one section's body (exit 1 when the card does not hold it); union the list hunks of a conflicted card, name the rest; on this node, merge cards by ## section (both versions kept and marked), and snapshot/presence/sense/read-mark files by their time |
| [`cards`](#cards) | move the overflow of over-long card sections into projects/history/ (dry run without --apply); merge two cards for the same project (dry run without --apply); fold a section a card holds twice (same heading, or two locales) into the live one |
| [`section`](#section) | write one section of a card |
| [`sections`](#sections) | card section keys → headings (localise via HUB/sections.json) |
| [`absorb`](#absorb) | fold a hub base written in isolation into this one, as a new node (dry run without --apply) |
| [`freeze`](#freeze) | stop mesh-sync on THIS node before operating on the hub dir |
| [`unfreeze`](#unfreeze) | let it sync again |
| [`resource`](#resource) | a resource card; infra/topology cards (hosts, vms, services, roles, ...); one resource + its in/out relationships |
| [`graph`](#graph) | typed relationship graph (runs_on/depends_on/deploys_to/...) |
| [`harvest`](#harvest) | print the Harvest Protocol prompt (also served as an MCP prompt) |
| [`prompts`](#prompts) | a role's rules from prompts/meta; --check: exit 1 if the file differs |
| [`claim`](#claim) | soft lock; start a task: a claim on it while you work; who holds a claim over this path |
| [`release`](#release) | release a lock |
| [`heartbeat`](#heartbeat) | record liveness |
| [`presence`](#presence) | fleet roster (who has heartbeated, alive/stale) |
| [`usage`](#usage) | what the work cost, measured and supplied; record what a piece of work cost |
| [`rules`](#rules) | the team's rules (AGENTS.md), or add one |
| [`operator`](#operator) | the operator's card |
| [`lint`](#lint) | the hub against its rules; exit 1 on findings |
| [`audit`](#audit) | declarations vs behaviour; --apply files each finding as an incident |
| [`sync`](#sync) | sync a project (-m = non-interactive) |
| [`install-hook`](#install-hook) | git post-commit hook |
| [`gc`](#gc) | what has piled up, by class — dry: touches nothing; archive it (moved, never deleted) and clear this node's litter |
| [`secret`](#secret) | values kept outside the replicated hub |
| [`queue`](#queue) | address work to a role; block until real content, then exit 0; the same, again and again; the role's ready tasks, as its queue; per role and node: delivered and pending; a conflicted queue file: ours in place, theirs appended; archive queue files nobody ever read; dead waiter markers, readers of a dead process, cursors this node cannot write; fold one message said --min times or more about one task into its newest copy |
| [`board`](#board) | every track: roles, done, next, blocked, and what waits for you |
| [`sense`](#sense) | a head's sensor: exit 0 = wake with this text, 1 = nothing |
| [`serve`](#serve) | read-only dashboard: summary, tracks, kanban, history |
| [`demo`](#demo) | write a demo hub into a new folder (default: the temp dir) to look at first; your hub is untouched |

## init

- `hub init [path]` — scaffold a team folder (AGENTS.md, INBOX.md, queues/)

## setup

- `hub setup --harness claude|gemini|opencode|omp|dsh --agent <name> [--scope user|project] [--hub <dir>] [--print | --prompt | --verify | --check | --uninstall]` — put hubd into a harness's MCP config, after trying the server; --check reads the config back and tries what it holds

## version

- `hub version | --version | -v` — installed hubd version, and which copy is answering

## doctor

- `hub doctor` — check hub base, team root, locks, queues and writer versions

## upgrade

- `hub upgrade` — refresh HUBD.md (the agent protocol) to the installed version

## status

- `hub status` — project table

## brief

- `hub brief [-h <hours>]` — morning brief

## inbox

- `hub inbox [--hours <N>]` — what needs a decision now (blocked/overdue/unassigned/stale locks)

## now

- `hub now [project] [--assignee <who>]` — the one next thing to do

Also: `hub whatnext`

## agenda

- `hub agenda [project]` — the day, split by who can act

## plan

- `hub plan [project]` — dependency-graph trajectory: ready now · critical path · unlock order · cycles

Also: `hub trajectory`

## whereami

- `hub whereami [cwd] [--json]` — where am I: project, digest age, tasks, claims, who is here, journal tail, git inventory — first command after a compaction

Also: `hub where`

## log

- `hub log [project] [-n 20] [--since 3h|<time>] [--agent <name>] [--to <role>] [--json]` — journal tail; --since: all of the window; --json: every field, to included

## watch

- `hub watch --as <name> [-p <proj>] [--since 1h] [--follow [--interval 5]] [--private] [--json | --exec <cmd>]` — new journal entries, each shown once to the cursor &lt;name>

  one pass and exit, or --follow; a new cursor starts now unless --since; --json: one entry per line; --exec: each entry to &lt;cmd> on stdin, marked when it exits 0

## recall

- `hub recall "<what do we know about X>" [--limit 20] [--stale-days N] [--json]` — ranked, dated hits across cards, tasks and the journal

## report

- `hub report [-p <proj>] [--reflect <json|file>]` — structured report → card sections (no input prints the template)

  DECIDE:/FACT:/HYPO:/COMM:/NEXT:/DONE:/TASK:/NOTE:/HANDOFF: lines, via stdin (heredoc) or -m; --reflect: the turn's reflection as checked fields

## reflect

- `hub reflect --project <proj> [--since 7d] [--level turn|head|fleet] [--json]` — the reflection digest: results and obstacles per role, the latest facts, repeated rules
- `hub reflect --promote --project <proj> [--since 7d]` — candidates for the project's laws: a rule said 3 times by one role, or by 2 roles
- `hub reflect --accept|--reject <id> --project <proj> --by <head>` — the head's verdict on a candidate; an accepted one is a law, in hub_context
- `hub reflect --laws --project <proj>` — the project's laws, one per line

## decide

- `hub decide "<what>" --why "<why>" -p <proj>` — append a decision to ## Decisions

## next

- `hub next "<the one next action>" -p <proj>` — set ## Next step

## task

- `hub task add "<text>" -p <proj> [-i high|med] [-d YYYY-MM-DD] [--needs 1,2] [--resource <slug>] --by <you>` — a new task
- `hub task done <id> --by <you>` — close a task
- `hub task list [-p proj] [--status open|done|all] [--json]` — tasks
- `hub task get <id> [--json]` — one task, and where else its id appears
- `hub task retag [--apply --by <you>]` — move categories off the fixed list into tags (dry run without --apply)

## card

- `hub card <slug> -m "<digest>"` — set a project card without a folder
- `hub card <slug> --replace "<old>" --with "<new>" [--append-line "<line>"]` — fix lines of a card, leave the rest byte-for-byte
- `hub card show <slug> [--section <heading|key>] [--json]` — read a card back: whole, its sections as data, or one section's body (exit 1 when the card does not hold it)
- `hub card resolve [slug...]` — union the list hunks of a conflicted card, name the rest
- `hub card merge-driver [--remove]` — on this node, merge cards by ## section (both versions kept and marked), and snapshot/presence/sense/read-mark files by their time

## cards

- `hub cards compact [--apply --by <you>]` — move the overflow of over-long card sections into projects/history/ (dry run without --apply)
- `hub cards merge <duplicate> <canonical> [--apply --by <you>]` — merge two cards for the same project (dry run without --apply)
- `hub cards merge-sections [--apply --by <you>]` — fold a section a card holds twice (same heading, or two locales) into the live one

## section

- `hub section add <project> <section> "<text>" --by <you> [--src <where>] [--set]` — write one section of a card

## sections

- `hub sections` — card section keys → headings (localise via HUB/sections.json)

## absorb

- `hub absorb <dir> --as <label> [--apply --by <you>]` — fold a hub base written in isolation into this one, as a new node (dry run without --apply)

## freeze

- `hub freeze "<why>" --by <you>` — stop mesh-sync on THIS node before operating on the hub dir

## unfreeze

- `hub unfreeze` — let it sync again

## resource

- `hub resource set <slug> [-m "<note>"] [--type host|vm|service|endpoint|provider|role] [--addr <a>] [--status live] [--link <rel>:<slug>] [--attr <k>=<v>]` — a resource card
- `hub resource list [--type <t>]` — infra/topology cards (hosts, vms, services, roles, ...)
- `hub resource get <slug>` — one resource + its in/out relationships

Also: `hub res`

## graph

- `hub graph [-p <proj>] [--type <t>]` — typed relationship graph (runs_on/depends_on/deploys_to/...)

## harvest

- `hub harvest` — print the Harvest Protocol prompt (also served as an MCP prompt)

## prompts

- `hub prompts render <template> [--vars <json|file>] [--out <file> | --check <file>]` — a role's rules from prompts/meta; --check: exit 1 if the file differs

## claim

- `hub claim <proj> <area> [-t min] [--note "<why>"] --agent <you>` — soft lock
- `hub claim --task <id> [-t min] --agent <you>` — start a task: a claim on it while you work
- `hub claim check <path> [-p <proj>] [--agent <you>]` — who holds a claim over this path

## release

- `hub release <id> | release --task <id> --agent <you>` — release a lock

## heartbeat

- `hub heartbeat <agent> [--role r] [--status s] [--task id] [--cwd path] [--ttl min]` — record liveness

## presence

- `hub presence [--role r] [--alive] [--json]` — fleet roster (who has heartbeated, alive/stale)

## usage

- `hub usage [--days 7] [-p <proj>] [--json]` — what the work cost, measured and supplied
- `hub usage add --agent <you> [--seconds N] [--tokens-in N] [--tokens-out N] [--cost <usd>] [--model m] [-p proj] [--task id]` — record what a piece of work cost

## rules

- `hub rules [--append "<rule>" --by <you>]` — the team's rules (AGENTS.md), or add one

## operator

- `hub operator` — the operator's card

## lint

- `hub lint` — the hub against its rules; exit 1 on findings

## audit

- `hub audit [--days 7] [--apply --by <you>]` — declarations vs behaviour; --apply files each finding as an incident

## sync

- `hub sync [path] [-m "<digest>"]` — sync a project (-m = non-interactive)

## install-hook

- `hub install-hook [path]` — git post-commit hook

## gc

- `hub gc [--days 14] [--json]` — what has piled up, by class — dry: touches nothing
- `hub gc --apply --by <you>` — archive it (moved, never deleted) and clear this node's litter

## secret

- `hub secret set|get|path|list|rm|backup|restore|verify <name>` — values kept outside the replicated hub

## queue

- `hub queue send <role> "<text>" --from <who> [--task <id>]` — address work to a role
- `hub queue wait <role> [--timeout <N>] [--as <subscriber>] [--from-now] [--tasks]` — block until real content, then exit 0
- `hub queue monitor <role> [--timeout <N>] [--once] [--as <sub>] [--from-now]` — the same, again and again
- `hub queue work <role> [--json]` — the role's ready tasks, as its queue
- `hub queue status [<role>] [--json]` — per role and node: delivered and pending
- `hub queue resolve [file...]` — a conflicted queue file: ours in place, theirs appended
- `hub queue gc [--days 30] [--apply]` — archive queue files nobody ever read
- `hub queue repair [--apply] [--json]` — dead waiter markers, readers of a dead process, cursors this node cannot write

  judged by the pid, not by age; --apply removes the markers and moves the readers to .qstate/_archive/; exit 1 while a cursor cannot be written
- `hub queue dedupe <role> [--min 5] [--apply] [--json]` — fold one message said --min times or more about one task into its newest copy

  copies a reader's watermark stands on stay; only a shard this node may rewrite; the dropped copies go to queues/archive/

## board

- `hub board [<project>] [--days 7] [--limit 8] [--all] [--json]` — every track: roles, done, next, blocked, and what waits for you

## sense

- `hub sense <head> [events|check <branch>|verdict <branch> accept|reject <text>|brief|status]` — a head's sensor: exit 0 = wake with this text, 1 = nothing

## serve

- `hub serve [-p 7777]` — read-only dashboard: summary, tracks, kanban, history

## demo

- `hub demo [dir]` — write a demo hub into a new folder (default: the temp dir) to look at first; your hub is untouched
